```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
source("tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/common_first_draft.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DBI)
  library(duckdb)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# ---- Toggles ----------------------------------------------------------------
save_tables <- FALSE  # set TRUE to write .tex fragments to tables_dir

# ---- Window ----------------------------------------------------------------
yr_anchor   <- 2024L
yr_lookback <- 10L
yr_new_min  <- yr_anchor - yr_lookback + 1L  # 2015
min_total_branches <- 5L

sod_duckdb_path   <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/sod/sod.duckdb"
ffiec_duckdb_path <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/call-reports-FFIEC/call-reports-ffiec.duckdb"
```

```{r sod-vintage}
# Pull full SOD UNINUMBR history; compute first_yr globally; restrict to 2024.
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = sod_duckdb_path, read_only = TRUE)

uninumbr_first <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT UNINUMBR, MIN(YEAR) AS first_yr
  FROM sod
  WHERE UNINUMBR IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UNINUMBR
"))

sod_2024 <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT RSSDID, UNINUMBR, YEAR, ASSET, ZIPBR, STCNTYBR
  FROM sod
  WHERE YEAR = %d
    AND RSSDID IS NOT NULL
    AND UNINUMBR IS NOT NULL
", yr_anchor)))

# Banks present in SOD at start of 10-year window (excludes banks chartered
# after yr_new_min, whose new_share_b would mechanically be 1.0).
banks_at_start <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT DISTINCT RSSDID FROM sod
  WHERE YEAR = %d AND RSSDID IS NOT NULL
", yr_new_min - 1L)))

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
banks_at_start[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
keep_at_start <- banks_at_start$RSSDID

sod_2024[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
sod_2024 <- merge(sod_2024, uninumbr_first, by = "UNINUMBR", all.x = TRUE)
sod_2024[, is_new_b := as.integer(first_yr >= yr_new_min)]
```

```{r bank-level-stock}
# Bank-level 2024: total branches, new branches, new share, network/scale.
sod_2024[, zip5  := sprintf("%05.0f", suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ZIPBR)))]
sod_2024[, state := substr(sprintf("%05.0f", suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STCNTYBR))), 1, 2)]

# Branch HHI across zips (count-based) per bank.
hhi_b <- sod_2024[, .(br = .N), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
hhi_b[, share := br / sum(br), by = RSSDID]
hhi_b <- hhi_b[, .(branch_hhi_b = sum(share^2)), by = RSSDID]

bank_lvl <- sod_2024[, .(
  n_total_2024_b   = .N,
  n_new_b          = sum(is_new_b, na.rm = TRUE),
  asset_thousands  = max(as.numeric(ASSET), na.rm = TRUE),
  n_states_b       = uniqueN(state)
), by = RSSDID]

bank_lvl[, new_share_b   := n_new_b / pmax(n_total_2024_b, 1)]
bank_lvl[, bank_assets   := asset_thousands * 1000]
bank_lvl[, mean_assets_b_bn := bank_assets / 1e9]
bank_lvl[, size_bucket   := assign_bucket(bank_assets)]

bank_lvl <- merge(bank_lvl, hhi_b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)

bank_lvl <- bank_lvl[!is.na(size_bucket) &
                     n_total_2024_b >= min_total_branches &
                     RSSDID %in% keep_at_start]
cat("Banks per bucket (present in", yr_new_min - 1L, "and 2024, >=",
    min_total_branches, "branches in 2024):\n")
print(bank_lvl[, .N, by = size_bucket])
```

```{r call-reports}
# Q4 2024 snapshot for chars; plus 2015 Q4 for asset CAGR.
keep_ids <- unique(bank_lvl$RSSDID)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ffiec_duckdb_path, read_only = TRUE)

bs_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         assets, qtr_avg_assets, deposits, transaction_dep,
         td_small, td_mid, td_large, brokered_dep,
         ln_tot, ln_re, ln_ci, ln_cons,
         securities, equity
  FROM bs_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year IN (%d, %d)
    AND assets > 0
", yr_new_min - 1L, yr_anchor)
bs <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, bs_sql))

is_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         ytdint_inc, ytdint_exp, ytdint_inc_net,
         ytdnonint_inc, ytdnonint_exp,
         ytdnetinc
  FROM is_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year = %d
", yr_anchor)
is_ <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, is_sql))

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

bs[, idrssd := as.character(idrssd)]
is_[, idrssd := as.character(idrssd)]

# 2024 snapshot for ratio computations.
bs24 <- bs[yr == yr_anchor]
cr   <- merge(bs24, is_, by = c("idrssd", "yr"), all.x = TRUE)
setnames(cr, "idrssd", "RSSDID")
cr <- cr[RSSDID %in% keep_ids]

# 2015 -> 2024 asset CAGR.
bs15 <- bs[yr == yr_new_min - 1L, .(idrssd, asset_2014 = assets)]
bs24w <- bs[yr == yr_anchor,      .(idrssd, asset_2024 = assets)]
cagr_dt <- merge(bs15, bs24w, by = "idrssd", all.x = FALSE, all.y = FALSE)
setnames(cagr_dt, "idrssd", "RSSDID")
cagr_dt[, asset_cagr := (asset_2024 / asset_2014)^(1 / (yr_anchor - (yr_new_min - 1L))) - 1]
cagr_dt <- cagr_dt[RSSDID %in% keep_ids, .(RSSDID, asset_cagr)]
```

```{r ratios}
cr[, denom_assets := pmax(assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_qavg   := pmax(qtr_avg_assets, assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_dep    := pmax(deposits, 1)]
cr[, denom_loans  := pmax(ln_tot,   1)]

cr[, revenue        := ytdint_inc_net + ytdnonint_inc]
cr[, time_dep_total := td_small + td_mid + td_large]

cr[, roa                := ytdnetinc      / denom_qavg]
cr[, nim                := ytdint_inc_net / denom_qavg]
cr[, eff_ratio          := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_exp / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, nonint_exp_assets  := ytdnonint_exp / denom_assets]
cr[, int_exp_assets     := ytdint_exp    / denom_assets]
cr[, nonint_inc_revenue := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_inc / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, loans_assets       := ln_tot     / denom_assets]
cr[, sec_assets         := securities / denom_assets]
cr[, ln_re_share        := ln_re      / denom_loans]
cr[, ln_ci_share        := ln_ci      / denom_loans]
cr[, ln_cons_share      := ln_cons    / denom_loans]
cr[, dep_assets         := deposits   / denom_assets]
cr[, trans_dep_share    := transaction_dep / denom_dep]
cr[, time_dep_share     := time_dep_total  / denom_dep]
cr[, brokered_dep_share := brokered_dep    / denom_dep]
cr[, rate_sens_dep_share := (time_dep_total + brokered_dep) / denom_dep]
cr[, equity_assets      := equity / denom_assets]

ratio_cols <- c("roa", "nim", "eff_ratio", "nonint_exp_assets", "int_exp_assets",
                "nonint_inc_revenue", "loans_assets", "sec_assets",
                "ln_re_share", "ln_ci_share", "ln_cons_share",
                "dep_assets", "trans_dep_share", "time_dep_share",
                "brokered_dep_share", "rate_sens_dep_share", "equity_assets")

cr_b <- cr[, c(.(RSSDID = RSSDID), lapply(.SD, function(x) x)),
           .SDcols = ratio_cols]
# Note: cr already one row per RSSDID at Q4 2024.  Use directly.
cr_b <- cr[, c("RSSDID", ratio_cols), with = FALSE]
cr_b <- merge(cr_b, cagr_dt, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a) || !nzchar(a)) b else a

winsor_in_place <- function(d, vars, p = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  for (v in vars) {
    x <- d[[v]]
    if (!is.numeric(x)) next
    set(d, j = v, value = winsor(x, p = p))
  }
  d
}

build_panel <- function(d, vars) {
  med <- median(d$new_share_b, na.rm = TRUE)
  d[, high_opener := as.integer(new_share_b >= med)]

  rows <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    x_low  <- d[high_opener == 0L, get(v)]; x_low  <- x_low[is.finite(x_low)]
    x_high <- d[high_opener == 1L, get(v)]; x_high <- x_high[is.finite(x_high)]
    if (length(x_low) < 2 || length(x_high) < 2) {
      return(data.table(
        Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
        Low      = "",
        High     = "",
        Diff     = "",
        t        = "",
        N_low    = format(length(x_low),  big.mark = ","),
        N_high   = format(length(x_high), big.mark = ",")
      ))
    }
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(x_high, x_low), error = function(e) NULL)
    diff <- mean(x_high) - mean(x_low)
    sig  <- if (!is.null(tt)) {
      if (tt$p.value < 0.01) "***"
      else if (tt$p.value < 0.05) "**"
      else if (tt$p.value < 0.10) "*"
      else ""
    } else ""

    data.table(
      Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
      Low      = sprintf("%.3f", mean(x_low)),
      High     = sprintf("%.3f", mean(x_high)),
      Diff     = sprintf("%.3f%s", diff, sig),
      t        = if (!is.null(tt)) sprintf("%.2f", tt$statistic) else "",
      N_low    = format(length(x_low),  big.mark = ","),
      N_high   = format(length(x_high), big.mark = ",")
    )
  })
  rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

emit_panel <- function(stats_dt, file_stem) {
  out_md <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".md"))
  md <- knitr::kable(stats_dt, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE,
                     align = "lrrrrrr")
  writeLines(as.character(md), out_md)
  cat("Wrote:", out_md, "\n")

  if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
    header <- "\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrr}\n\\toprule\n"
    col_names <- paste(c("Variable", "Low", "High", "Diff", "$t$",
                         "$N_{\\text{low}}$", "$N_{\\text{high}}$"),
                       collapse = " & ")
    body_lines <- apply(stats_dt, 1L, function(r) {
      paste(c(r[["Variable"]], r[["Low"]], r[["High"]], r[["Diff"]],
              r[["t"]],        r[["N_low"]], r[["N_high"]]),
            collapse = " & ")
    })
    body <- paste(paste0(body_lines, " \\\\"), collapse = "\n")
    tex <- paste0(header,
                  col_names, " \\\\\n\\midrule\n",
                  body, "\n",
                  "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
    out_tex <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tex"))
    writeLines(tex, out_tex)
    cat("Wrote:", out_tex, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r per-bucket}
display_vars <- c(
  # --- Lending franchise (story-block 1) -----------------------------------
  "loans_assets", "ln_re_share", "ln_ci_share", "ln_cons_share",
  # --- Balance-sheet alternative (large-bank tilt) -------------------------
  "sec_assets",
  # --- Funding rate-sensitivity (story-block 2) ----------------------------
  "int_exp_assets", "time_dep_share", "brokered_dep_share",
  "trans_dep_share", "dep_assets",
  # --- Fee income (large-bank tilt) ----------------------------------------
  "nonint_inc_revenue",
  # --- Profitability / cost ------------------------------------------------
  "roa", "nim", "eff_ratio", "nonint_exp_assets",
  # --- Capital -------------------------------------------------------------
  "equity_assets",
  # --- Scale / network / growth -------------------------------------------
  "mean_assets_b_bn", "n_total_2024_b", "n_states_b", "branch_hhi_b",
  "asset_cagr",
  # --- Vintage stats (context) ---------------------------------------------
  "n_new_b", "new_share_b"
)

# Don't winsorize integer counts; do winsorize all the ratios + share + cagr.
winsor_vars <- setdiff(display_vars,
                       c("n_states_b", "n_total_2024_b", "n_new_b"))

panel_big <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "ge_100bn"])
panel_mid <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "10_100bn"])
panel_sml <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "1_10bn"])

panel_big <- winsor_in_place(panel_big, winsor_vars)
panel_mid <- winsor_in_place(panel_mid, winsor_vars)
panel_sml <- winsor_in_place(panel_sml, winsor_vars)

stats_big <- build_panel(panel_big, display_vars)
stats_mid <- build_panel(panel_mid, display_vars)
stats_sml <- build_panel(panel_sml, display_vars)

emit_panel(stats_big, "tab_cross_section_new_branches_big")
emit_panel(stats_mid, "tab_cross_section_new_branches_mid")
emit_panel(stats_sml, "tab_cross_section_new_branches_sml")
```

```{r story-table}
# Curated 7-variable table that contrasts the lending/funding tilt of small &
# mid high-vintage banks vs the fee/securities tilt of large high-vintage
# banks.  One row per variable; six numeric columns (Low / High per bucket)
# with significance stars on the High cell when the within-bucket Welch t-test
# rejects equality.

story_vars <- c(
  "loans_assets",         # lending franchise
  "ln_re_share",          # lending franchise
  "sec_assets",           # alternative balance sheet
  "int_exp_assets",       # rate sensitivity (cost)
  "rate_sens_dep_share",  # rate sensitivity (mix)
  "nonint_inc_revenue",   # fee income (large-bank channel)
  "asset_cagr"            # growth
)

story_cell <- function(d, v, side) {
  med  <- median(d$new_share_b, na.rm = TRUE)
  flag <- d$new_share_b >= med
  x_low  <- d[!flag, get(v)];  x_low  <- x_low[is.finite(x_low)]
  x_high <- d[ flag, get(v)];  x_high <- x_high[is.finite(x_high)]
  if (length(x_low) < 2 || length(x_high) < 2) return("")
  if (side == "low")  return(sprintf("%.3f", mean(x_low)))
  tt <- tryCatch(t.test(x_high, x_low), error = function(e) NULL)
  sig <- if (!is.null(tt)) {
    if (tt$p.value < 0.01) "***"
    else if (tt$p.value < 0.05) "**"
    else if (tt$p.value < 0.10) "*"
    else ""
  } else ""
  sprintf("%.3f%s", mean(x_high), sig)
}

story_dt <- data.table(
  Variable = vapply(story_vars, function(v) label_lookup[v] %||% v, character(1)),
  `Big Low`  = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_big, v, "low"),  character(1)),
  `Big High` = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_big, v, "high"), character(1)),
  `Mid Low`  = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_mid, v, "low"),  character(1)),
  `Mid High` = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_mid, v, "high"), character(1)),
  `Sml Low`  = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_sml, v, "low"),  character(1)),
  `Sml High` = vapply(story_vars, function(v) story_cell(panel_sml, v, "high"), character(1))
)

out_md <- file.path(tables_dir, "tab_new_branches_story.md")
writeLines(as.character(knitr::kable(story_dt, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE,
                                     align = "lrrrrrr")), out_md)
cat("Wrote:", out_md, "\n")

if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
  header <- paste0("\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrr}\n\\toprule\n",
                   " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{$\\geq$\\$100B}",
                   " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\$10B--\\$100B}",
                   " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\$1B--\\$10B} \\\\\n",
                   "\\cmidrule(lr){2-3}\\cmidrule(lr){4-5}\\cmidrule(lr){6-7}\n",
                   "Variable & Low & High & Low & High & Low & High \\\\\n",
                   "\\midrule\n")
  body_lines <- apply(story_dt, 1L, function(r)
    paste(c(r[["Variable"]], r[["Big Low"]], r[["Big High"]],
            r[["Mid Low"]],  r[["Mid High"]], r[["Sml Low"]], r[["Sml High"]]),
          collapse = " & "))
  body <- paste(paste0(body_lines, " \\\\"), collapse = "\n")
  tex  <- paste0(header, body, "\n\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
  out_tex <- file.path(tables_dir, "tab_new_branches_story.tex")
  writeLines(tex, out_tex)
  cat("Wrote:", out_tex, "\n")
}

print(knitr::kable(story_dt, format = "pipe"))
```

```{r density-figure}
# Density of share-of-2024-branches-opened-2015-2024, three panels by size.
bucket_levels <- c("ge_100bn", "10_100bn", "1_10bn")
bucket_label_short <- c(ge_100bn = ">=$100B",
                        `10_100bn` = "$10B-$100B",
                        `1_10bn`   = "$1B-$10B")

dens_dt <- panel[, .(RSSDID, size_bucket, new_share_b)][!is.na(new_share_b)]
dens_dt[, bucket := factor(bucket_label_short[size_bucket],
                           levels = unname(bucket_label_short))]

med_dt <- dens_dt[, .(med = median(new_share_b, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mn  = mean(new_share_b,   na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = bucket]

p_dens <- ggplot(dens_dt, aes(x = new_share_b)) +
  geom_density(fill = primary_blue, color = primary_blue, alpha = 0.30,
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(data = med_dt, aes(xintercept = med),
             color = primary_gold, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ bucket, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Share of 2024 branches opened 2015-2024",
       y = "Density", title = NULL) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

if (isTRUE(save_figures)) {
  out_png <- file.path(figures_dir, "fig_new_share_density.png")
  ggsave(out_png, plot = p_dens, width = 10, height = 3.5,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  cat("Wrote:", out_png, "\n")
}
```
